title: Create: Lactose Intolerance
description: This is a simple mod I made that adds an exaggerated way of experiencing lactose intolerance :) using the create mod to create the different types of milk in the mod
body:
Commands:

/lactoseintolerance enable <player>

Items: 
- Low Lactose Milk
- High Lactose Milk
- Extremely High Lactose Milk
- Lactose-Free Milk

NOTE: This mod is in beta so may have some bugs or missing features.
